role: Proposed desktop workbench for designing and generating new programming languages
maturity: Repository shell with placeholder README; product architecture is proposed and not implemented.

layers.name: Experience
layers.responsibility: Desktop UI, CLI and operator workflows.

layers.name: Contracts
layers.responsibility: Public APIs, schemas, project manifests, plugin descriptors and events.

layers.name: Application orchestration
layers.responsibility: Use cases, workflows, command dispatch and lifecycle sequencing.

layers.name: Domain kernel
layers.responsibility: Core domain models, deterministic algorithms and product invariants.

layers.name: Policy and capabilities
layers.responsibility: Permissions, safety gates, trust, budgets and operation allowlists.

layers.name: Ports and contracts
layers.responsibility: Abstract OS, hardware, compiler, storage and provider interfaces.

layers.name: Adapters and platform
layers.responsibility: Concrete native OS, device, compiler and external-source implementations.

layers.name: State and artifacts
layers.responsibility: Project state, configuration, registries, generated output and provenance.

layers.name: Runtime and delivery
layers.responsibility: Build, packaging, deployment, process isolation and runtime composition.

layers.name: Assurance and evidence
layers.responsibility: Tests, benchmarks, compatibility and target-qualification evidence.

vertical_slices.title: Create a new language
vertical_slices.flow: User intent → structured language spec → grammar/type/semantic validation → generated frontend → conformance fixtures → versioned project.

vertical_slices.title: Compile a sample program
vertical_slices.flow: Source → lexer/parser → AST → semantic analysis → typed IR → verified transforms → backend adapter → artifact and diagnostics.

vertical_slices.title: Add a new backend
vertical_slices.flow: Versioned backend contract → capability declaration → adapter implementation → differential tests → package compatibility gate.

vertical_slices.title: Extension ecosystem
vertical_slices.flow: Extension manifest → trust/provenance check → permission review → isolated worker → bounded execution → audit record.

guardrails: Treat all compiler backends, generated programs and extensions as untrusted until validated and isolated. Do not start by promising arbitrary automatic creation of production-ready languages. First ship a deterministic language-spec model, validator and one vertical compiler pipeline with tests. Never execute generated code in the desktop process by default.
status_note: Proposed architecture only; verify future features with source, tests and platform evidence.
